reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Country/territory in ISO scope is distinct from sovereignty, jurisdiction, statistical area, sales territory and locality. A place label is not a globally unique key. Country context is necessary but insufficient for same-named settlements; postcode associations can be many-to-many. Retain leading zeros and historical/category scope. Implement a versioned raw-value-to-reviewed-code bridge with ambiguity and unmatched outputs before external lookup. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results. Examined 13 physical field-role hypotheses for this group; their individual dispositions govern implementation.
